title: Locker Rental: late fee, past-due grace period and reactivation terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the flat fee charged when a scheduled monthly fee fails to collect, the number of consecutive missed charges after which a rental is marked past due, the notice given before that marking, the number of days a rental may remain past due before administrative closure becomes possible, and the fee charged to reinstate a past-due rental. The rule governing when a past-due rental may actually be administratively closed is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Late fee, suspension and grace-period table
| Tier | Late fee | Missed charges before past-due marking | Notice before marking | Past-due grace period | Reactivation fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | $5.00 | 2 | 5 calendar days | 15 calendar days | $0 |
| Medium Locker | $5.00 | 2 | 5 calendar days | 15 calendar days | $0 |
| Large Locker | $5.00 | 2 | 5 calendar days | 15 calendar days | $0 |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | $10.00 | 3 | 7 calendar days | 15 calendar days | $0 |
| Day-Use Locker | $0 | 1 | 0 calendar days | 1 calendar day | $0 |
| VIP Locker Suite | $10.00 | 3 | 10 calendar days | 20 calendar days | $0 |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- How long may a Small Locker rental remain past due before it may be administratively closed? Fifteen calendar days.
- Is any fee charged to reinstate a past-due rental? No; the reactivation fee is fixed at zero for every tier.
- Which tier allows the longest past-due grace period? The VIP Locker Suite, at twenty calendar days.
- After how many missed charges is a VIP Locker Suite rental marked past due? Three consecutive missed charges.

## Points of judgement
The past-due grace period fixed for the Day-Use Locker tier, one calendar day, is markedly shorter than every other tier's, consistent with that tier's short-cycle, non-monthly billing; a rental in that tier accordingly reaches eligibility for administrative closure far sooner after being marked past due than a Small, Medium, Large, Premium Climate-Controlled or VIP tier rental would.
